newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs up as report highlights broker buy.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs up as report highlights broker buy.

text.p: Shares in drug group Cortecs International Plc jumped higher in pre-market trade on Tuesday, after a press report said one brokerage was poised to issue a "buy" note on the stock, dealers said.
Cortecs, which on Monday dropped to its lowest level since the end of January, was up 13-1/2p at 225 by 0709 GMT in volume of 50,000 shares.

A report in the Daily Mail said a "buy" note from Nomura would be delivered to fund managers today and that the brokerage was planning briefings on the company with UK and European institutions through the next 10 days.
Analysts at Nomura were not immediately available for comment.
